item.title: HS ROUNDUP: Abington Heights edges Scranton in a key Division I girls basketball game
item.description: Abby Schneider made a pair of free throws to provide No. 4 Abington Heights a three-point lead with 15 seconds remaining and the cushion needed to post a 46-43 win over No. 5 Scranton on Friday night in a Lackawanna League Division I girls basketball game. Sydney Pallman led the Lady Comets (13-5, 8-2) with 17 points. She made five of six free throws in the fourth quarter to help secure the win. item.title: Rotary Club of the Abingtons welcomes new member
item.description: Sergio Marzitelli was welcomed as a new member of the Rotary Club of the Abingtons. From left: Marcia Loughman, installing Rotary member and past district governor; Marzitelli; Gail Mason Cicerini, sponsoring member; Chris Loftus, Abingtons Rotary president; and sponsor and Scranton Club member and past president Justin Shaffern.

item.title: Knights of Columbus Coats for Kids campaign
item.description: The Knights of Columbus Corpus Christi Council 12573 purchased several boxes of new winter coats that will be distributed through the Lakeland School District. The coats are for boys and girls, with many fashionable colors and sizes. They were purchased as part of the Knights of Columbus Coats for Kids campaign, which is run throughout the U.S. and Canada. item.title: Clipboard, January 31, 2026
item.description: Browndale Spring cash raffle: The members of the all-volunteer Browndale Fire Company are selling cash raffle tickets to benefit the services and operation of the fire company. Ticket donation is $20; only 600 tickets will be sold, and there are 16 cash prizes. Prizes will be awarded at the March 10 meeting at 7:30 p.m. All tickets pulled will be put back into the drawing, making chances greater of winning a prize. item.title: GIRLS BASKETBALL: Bestrycki, defense lead Scranton Prep past North Pocono
item.description: SCRANTON — Defense set the tone for Scranton Prep and enabled it to build a lead in its showdown with North Pocono on Friday night. Shannon Bestrycki’s shooting secured the victory for the Classics. The sophomore hit six 3-pointers and scored a game-high 22 points to lead No. 2 Scranton Prep past the No. 1 Lady Trojans, 52-37, in a rough-and-tumble Lackawanna League Division I girls basketball game at the Xavier Center’s Keller Court.
